chunks: Al-Saffar, from Ahmad, from Shadhan, from Yahya ibn Abi Talhah: that he asked a righteous servant about a man who touched the private part of his wife or his slave-girl, playing with her until she ejaculated: is ghusl obligatory upon her or not? He said:
"Has she not ejaculated from desire?" I said: "Yes." He said: "Ghusl is obligatory upon her."

key_terms.يَعْبَثُ بِهَا: He fondles or plays with her sexually

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl if she ejaculates from desire?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning janabah and ritual purity. It states that if a woman ejaculates from desire, ghusl is obligatory upon her.
